info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - archive
info.description:
Configuration for `/native/archive` (18 descendants)

**YANG Model:** [Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - archive.yang](https://github.com/YangModels/yang/blob/main/vendor/cisco/xe/17181/Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - archive.yang)

get.description:
Retrieve archive configuration from the device via RESTCONF.

Returns the current operational or configuration state of this resource.

put.description:
Create or replace archive configuration on the device.

This replaces the entire resource — any fields not included will be removed.

Partially update archive configuration on the device.

Only the fields included in the request body are modified; other fields remain unchanged.

Remove archive configuration from the device configuration.

This deletes the resource and all descendant data.
